IBPS RRB Prelims in short

IBPS RRB PO & Clerk Prelims: 80 questions in 45 minutes (Reasoning 40, Quantitative Aptitude 40). A right answer gets 1 mark and a wrong one loses 0.25; a skipped question costs nothing. Each section has its own clock (Reasoning 25 min, Quantitative Aptitude 20 min). That is about 34 seconds a question.

80 questions × 1 mark = 80 marks. Reasoning has 25 minutes and Quant 20, one after the other; you can’t go back to a section once its time is up.

The same prelims serve Officer Scale I (PO) and Office Assistant (Clerk), where the quant section is called Numerical Ability. Prelims decide who goes on to the mains; their marks are not added to the final merit.

How the scoring works

Every wrong answer takes marks away, so a skipped question can be worth more than a guess.

Say you answer 55 right and 12 wrong in the whole paper:

55 × 1 − 12 × 0.25 = 55 − 3 = 52

On average, a blind guess among four options gains about 0.06 of a mark; ruling out two options first raises that to about 0.38 of a mark.

Try two questions

Made by Takkar’s question engine in IBPS RRB style, with every answer calculated, not copied. Allow yourself 34 seconds each.

Approximation

What is the approximate value of 32.08 × 19.08 − 261.04 ÷ 9.02?

  1. 579
  2. 479
  3. 679
  4. 529
Show the answer and steps

Answer: A. 579

  1. Round each number: 32 × 19 − 261 ÷ 9
  2. 32 × 19 = 608, and 261 ÷ 9 = 29
  3. 608 − 29 = 579

Inequalities

Statement: L ≥ M < S < N > Q
Conclusions:
I. L < N
II. S > M

  1. Both I and II follow
  2. Neither I nor II follows
  3. Only II follows
  4. Either I or II follows
Show the answer and steps

Answer: C. Only II follows

  1. I. L < N: the signs between them point both ways, so it is not certain
  2. II. S > M: this is certain from the statement

IBPS RRB questions people ask

Is there negative marking in IBPS RRB Prelims?

Yes. 0.25 of a mark is deducted for each wrong answer, and a right answer gets 1 mark. A skipped question costs nothing.

Does IBPS RRB Prelims have sectional timing?

Yes. You get 25 minutes for Reasoning and 20 minutes for Quantitative Aptitude, 45 minutes in all, and you can’t go back to a section once its time is up.

Which sections are in IBPS RRB Prelims?

2 sections: Reasoning (40 questions), Quantitative Aptitude (40 questions). 80 questions in all.

How can I practise IBPS RRB quant and reasoning every day for free?

On Takkar, each duel gives you ten new questions, five quant and five reasoning, in IBPS RRB marking and timing, with step-by-step solutions. It’s free in any browser at playtakkar.in/play, with no sign-up.
